description: This file contains unit tests for the HasGlobalErrors matcher class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing the behavior of matching global errors on Errors objects.

classes.name: HasGlobalErrorsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the HasGlobalErrors matcher, testing various scenarios of matching global errors in Errors objects.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test variables before each test.

methods.name: shouldAppendGlobalErrorsDescriptionIfCodeIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that the description for global errors without a specific code is correctly generated.

methods.name: shouldAppendGlobalErrorsDescriptionWithCodeIfCodeIsNonNull
methods.description: Checks that the description includes the specific error code when provided.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfCodeIsNullAndGivenErrorHasNoGlobalErrors
methods.description: Ensures that the matcher does not match when no global errors are present.

methods.name: shouldMatchIfCodeIsNullAndGivenErrorHasGlobalErrors
methods.description: Ensures that the matcher matches when global errors are present and no specific code is required.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfCodeIsNonNullAndGivenErrorDoesNotHaveGlobalErrors
methods.description: Checks that the matcher does not match when global errors do not contain the specified code.

methods.name: shouldNotMatchIfCodeIsNonNullButNotContainedInGivenErrors
methods.description: Checks that the matcher does not match when the specific error code isn't in the global errors.

methods.name: shouldMatchIfCodeIsNonNullAndContainedInGivenErrors
methods.description: Verifies that the matcher successfully matches when the specific error code is present among global errors.
